request.query: If 0 <= a < b^t, b > 1, k and N natural with t*k <= N and N positive, then a^k < b^N including k=0

items.name: Nat.lt_pow_of_log_lt
items.type: ∀ {b x y : ℕ}, 1 < b → Nat.log b y < x → y < b ^ x

items.name: pow_lt_pow_left₀
items.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M₀] {a b : M₀} [PosMulStrictMono M₀]
  [MulPosMono M₀], a < b → 0 ≤ a → ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → a ^ n < b ^ n

items.name: zpow_lt_zpow_right₀
items.type:
∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder G₀] [PosMulReflectLT G₀] {a : G₀} [ZeroLEOneClass G₀]
  {m n : ℤ}, 1 < a → m < n → a ^ m < a ^ n

items.name: pow_le_pow_iff_right₀
items.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M₀] {a : M₀} {m n : ℕ} [PosMulStrictMono M₀]
  [ZeroLEOneClass M₀], 1 < a → (a ^ n ≤ a ^ m ↔ n ≤ m)

items.name: zpow_le_zpow_left₀
items.type:
∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder G₀] [PosMulReflectLT G₀] {a b : G₀} [MulPosMono G₀]
  {n : ℤ}, 0 ≤ n → 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → a ^ n ≤ b ^ n
